specs.name: Storage
specs.value: TF Card, Supports up to 128GB SDHC

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 1 x USB 2.0 HOST, 1 x USB 3.0 HOST, 1 x USB Type-C

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: Default 2 x RS232 (Optional 6 x RS232 at most, include 1 debug port)

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS485. Optionally, these 2 x RS485 can be configured to RS232.

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: Default to 2 x CAN. Optionally, these 2 x CAN can be configured to RS232.

specs.name: GPIO
specs.value: 8 Channels Isolated IO, 4 x Input and 4 x Output

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: Integrated WiFi/BT Module (Bluetooth is functional on Yocto Linux, not functional on Android)
